findings.title: Public member lists silently truncate at 50
findings.description: `findMembers()` now fetches only 50 members, but the public members template has no pagination controls or further loading. Custom groups previously displayed all members; members beyond the first page are now inaccessible. Add public pagination alongside the server-side limit.

findings.title: Removing membership leaves the primary group assigned
findings.description: Directly deleting membership bypasses the previous `Group#usernames=` deletion workflow, whose `destroy_deletions` callback also clears matching `User.primary_group_id` values. Removed users can therefore retain the group’s label through `PostSerializer#primary_group_name`. Preserve that cleanup and test removal of a primary-group member.

findings.title: Exact page multiples produce an empty extra page
findings.description: `Math.floor(count / limit) + 1` reports two pages for 50 members and three for 100. Next remains enabled on the actual last page and navigates to an empty page. Use `Math.ceil(count / limit)` and test exact multiples. The calculation was reproduced against the controller source.

findings.title: Adding existing members raises a uniqueness error
findings.description: Every submitted username is pushed into the association without checking membership. The unique `(group_id, user_id)` index rejects existing members. This is particularly easy to trigger because the new Add action leaves submitted usernames selected. Make additions idempotent and test repeated submissions and mixed existing/new members.
